fields.gap: sigma_local = 0.6*E*t_w/r_o is SP-8007 classical with gamma=1 (no imperfection knockdown). At the aluminum best, local sits 3.9x above the least SF, so the answer is robust; at the T700 best the margin is 1.18x, and a gamma of 0.65 would pull that point's local to ~0.59.
fields.direction: Re-optimise r_o under a knocked-down local curve: at s=1 the local margin is 2.6x, so the material conclusion (T700 least ~0.76, yield-bound) survives down to gamma ~0.29 after re-optimisation.
fields.effect: The best-point geometry moves; the least SF per material does not.
